description: Find state-licensed home-trade businesses by trade, city, state, ZIP, license number or free text; filters combine. Every result has an active license on the state board's register (with the date it was checked), plus a score (0-100) and rank within its city from theoPros' published formula. Example: 'a licensed roofer in Miami with no complaints' is city='Miami', trade='roofers', no_complaints=true. Ordered by text relevance when q is set, otherwise by score with unscored listings last. Up to 100 per page; pass next_cursor to get the next page.

lead_safe.description: Only lead-safe (RRP) certified firms, by EPA or the state's own program (needed for paint work in homes built before 1978)

licence.description: License number as the board writes it, e.g. '1027925' (CA), '335498' or 'ROC335498' (AZ), 'CCC1328295' (FL)

limit.description: Results per page, default 20, at most 100

no_complaints.description: Only businesses with no open complaints or disciplinary actions on the register; states whose board publishes none are excluded

q.description: Free text: business name, license number, phone, ZIP, neighborhood or service such as 'cabinet'

sort.description: Order: score (the default without q; unscored listings last), years licensed, Google rating or review count. With q the default is relevance

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the business's mailing address

name: search_pros
title: Search licensed pros
